# Report: `NUI.Input` implementation

## API

```elm
view       : Theme -> Options msg -> Element msg          -- the input (owns value)
group      : List (Element msg) -> Element msg            -- n-input-group
groupLabel : Theme -> { size : Size, bordered : Bool } -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
defaults   : Options msg
InputType(..) = Text | Password | Textarea
Status(..)    = Success | Warning | Error
```

**Options**: `value`, `onInput : Maybe (String -> msg)`, `placeholder : Maybe String`, `size`, `type_`, `status : Maybe Status`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `round`, `clearable`, `bordered`, `stateful`, `resizable`, `rows`, `maxlength`, `minlength`, `prefix`, `suffix` (both `Element msg`).

## Emitted structure (jsdom-verified)

```
div.n-input .n-input--{size}-size [--{status}-status] [--disabled] [--textarea]
     [--resizable (textarea && resizable)] [--round && !textarea] [--stateful]   style="--n-*"
├─ div.n-input-wrapper                         (Element.row)
│  ├─ div.n-input__prefix                      (Element.row, optional)
│  ├─ div.n-input__input | .n-input__textarea  (raw Html — see conflicts)
│  │  ├─ input.n-input__input-el / textarea.n-input__textarea-el   (value/placeholder/disabled/readonly/rows/max/min/onInput)
│  │  └─ div.n-input__placeholder [ > span ]   (input case has span; textarea raw text; only when value empty)
│  └─ div.n-input__suffix                      (Element.row, when clearable || suffix)
│     ├─ div.n-base-clear > div.n-base-clear__clear[data-clear] > div.n-base-icon > svg(ClearIcon)
│     │        (or .n-base-clear__placeholder when nothing to clear — reserves the 1em slot)
│     └─ user suffix
├─ div.n-input__border
└─ div.n-input__state-border

group:      div.n-input-group
groupLabel: div.n-input-group-label (style="--n-*") > inline-wrapped children + div.n-input-group-label__border
```

Click on clear dispatches `onInput ""` (Naive's `doUpdateValue('', {source:'clear'})`).

## `--n-*` vars (50, faithful port of `cssVarsRef`)

`--n-bezier -count-text-color -count-text-color-disabled -color -color-hover -font-size -font-weight -border-radius -height -padding-left -padding-right -text-color -caret-color -text-decoration-color -border -border-disabled -border-hover -border-focus -placeholder-color -placeholder-color-disabled -icon-size -line-height-textarea -color-disabled -color-focus -text-color-disabled -box-shadow-focus -loading-color` + full warning/error sets (`-caret-color-warning/error -color-focus-warning/error -box-shadow-focus-warning/error -border-warning/error -border-focus-warning/error -border-hover-warning/error -loading-color-warning/error`) + clear set (`-clear-color -clear-size -clear-color-hover -clear-color-pressed`) + `-icon-color(-hover/-pressed/-disabled) -suffix-text-color`.

`--n-padding-left/right` come from a port of seemly's `getPadding` (medium → `12px`/`12px`, verified). Group label emits its own 8 vars (incl. size-keyed `--n-font-size`/`--n-height`).

## elm-ui / CSS conflicts (for central bridge attention)

1. **`.n-base-clear` / `.n-base-clear__clear` / `.n-base-icon` rules are missing from `css/naive-ui.css`** — the extractor only walks `src/<comp>/src/styles`, not `_internal/*/styles`. I ported the static rules as inline styles (using `var(--n-clear-*)` which resolve from the root). **Cannot inline `:hover`/`:active`** — recommend adding centrally to `tools/bridge.css`:
   ```css
   .nui-root.nui-root .n-base-clear__clear:hover { color: var(--n-clear-color-hover) !important; }
   .nui-root.nui-root .n-base-clear__clear:active { color: var(--n-clear-color-pressed) !important; }
   ```
2. **Focus ring needs state**: Naive toggles `.n-input--focus` from JS focus tracking; stateless Elm can't. Without it the focus background + `--n-border-focus`/`--n-box-shadow-focus` never show. A central `:focus-within` bridge rule could restore it if desired.
3. **elm-ui `.s { flex-shrink: 0 }` vs Naive's default `flex-shrink: 1`** on `.n-input__input`: an elm-ui wrapper would make long values overflow the box instead of clipping — that's why `.n-input__input`/`.n-input__textarea` are raw `Html` (embedded via `Element.html`, exactly Naive's DOM; verified `flex-shrink: 1`, `display: block`). The `input-el + placeholder` sibling selector works (`Element.html` children are direct DOM children — verified: placeholder gets `display:flex; align-items:center`).
4. `groupLabel` children get an inline `display:inline-block; line-height:var(--n-height)` wrapper — elm-ui elements are block-level with `line-height:1` (`.s`), which would break the label's `inline-block` vertical centering.

## Deviations / skipped

- **Clear icon shows whenever value is non-empty** (Naive reveals on hover/focus only) — no internal state.
